Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the chat this morning. Our AP team needs a short packet to add Redwood as an approved supplier in our SAP system. Two quick items that block enrollment:

1) Legal / tax evidence: for EU payments we need your VAT certificate showing EU VAT registration (or confirmation of reverse-charge applicability). PDF is fine.
2) Invoice header and PO handling: our platform requires invoices that meet these rules: 1) invoice header must include our full company legal name (SageBridge Systems SpA), 2) invoice number format must allow insertion of our PO number (we prefer you append -SBPO<PO#> to your invoice id), and 3) a separate line showing VAT treatment (exempt / reverse-charge).

Can you confirm Redwood can: 1) provide a VAT cert, 2) include the PO token in the invoice number as above, and 3) show a separate VAT treatment line?

If you prefer, we can accept a short signed supplier form (attached) and a sample invoice for internal testing.

Best,
